experiment: Three top_k values, three independent first-turn trials each
request: знайди в документації один раз і скажи і спред, і денний ліміт переказів для Tier 2

metric_conventions.recall: Coverage of two requested facts in retrieved context; no-search trial is not applicable.
metric_conventions.precision: Target fragment occurrences divided by all returned occurrences over all searches, including repeats.
metric_conventions.faithfulness: Only the two requested numeric statements per complete answer.
metric_conventions.completeness: All three trials per group are retained, including the no-search failure.
metric_conventions.cost: Whole-turn input/output tokens; not billed cost.

first_two_trials_with_same_tool_route.limitation: Descriptive subset only; queries differ and this was not a separate randomized cost experiment.

provisional_decision.rationale: Both 4 and 5 achieved three complete one-search answers; 4 has better target precision (0.5 versus 0.4) and avoids the fifth non-target fragment for this question.
provisional_decision.tradeoff: Less retrieval breadth for other questions; three trials on one question do not establish general reliability. Not selected on a claim of lower observed whole-turn mean tokens.
provisional_decision.mandate: Ship it with regression checks and explicit remaining risks.
provisional_decision.revisit_when: Broader corpus-grounded cases show important facts missing at 4 but recovered at 5, with acceptable measured full-run cost.
provisional_decision.pending: Broken-index top_k5 check completed in d946930c: tariffs.md#b4 absent, allowance still unavailable, observed coverage improved from 0/2 to 1/2. Full homework still requires cases, eval reports and remaining report sections.
